clue.text: One of them to a cell is the norm among monks

definitions.text: One of them to a cell is the norm among monks

parts.words: One of them to a cell is the norm among monks
parts.note: monks are men who live in cells; a biologist's cell in a male body carries exactly one of these sex chromosomes

explanation.surface: A remark on the monastic rule of one monk to each cell.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'cell' is a monk's room in the surface but a body cell in the answer: every male cell holds one such chromosome, and monks are all men.
explanation.definitionFit: Males carry a single copy of this sex chromosome in each body cell, which monks, being men, all share.
